title: 6 针锋相对27 信件丢失及开解嫂子
content_zh:
6 针锋相对（2）
先前唐朝风气很是开放，女子穿得袒胸露乳，抛头露面，好不自在，但到了宋朝后，便渐渐地压低了女子的地位，到了本朝，更是变本加厉，已演变为大家闺秀得大门不出，二门不迈，并且不得随意与外男相见的地步。
而大庆朝开国伊始，太祖皇帝打下江山后，渐渐重用文人，至高祖皇帝时期，文官派的权利已逐渐放大，而武将则渐渐淡出政治权利核心。由文官集团领导下的大庆朝，男子在家室中权利空前提高，而女子，则渐渐被龟缩在内宅里，依附于男子而生存，并轻易不得外出。尤其钟鼎鸣食之家，对女子的言谈妇容更是严厉。方家自恃书香门弟，对姑娘的教养也是异常看重的。
如情虽为穿越女，但到了这儿后，除了努力适应外，也找不着其他法子了。她没有如善敢于抗争并为自己争取的奋发向上精神，也及不上如真如美顶着嫡女光环在不如自己的人前可以傲视群芳，就算在高门贵妇面前，也是挺直了腰杆做人了。
话说，对于那些或同情或怜悯或讥嘲或不屑的眼光，如情大都已经不大在乎了，但，遇上极个别的，也是会勃然大怒的。比如，上一回在代王府遇上的郡主，及眼前这个总爱找自己麻烦的李骁，明知这些人身份高贵，拧她十个脑袋都不敢得罪的人物……可是，可是，一瞧到这些目中无人的嘴脸，她真的很想不顾一切拿鞋子抽了。
李骁被反讽了回来，又立马挑眉道：“这么说来，姑娘是在埋怨太祖爷爷昏庸无能了？”这话说得有些严厉了，并且又涉及到质疑、埋怨太祖皇帝的罪名，在场诸人，渐渐变了脸色。
知义眉头皱得更凶了，不满地瞪了李骁，正想说话，然如情居然先一步开口道：“王爷此话可就过了。太祖皇帝丰功伟绩，说个三天三日都说不完。他老人家订下的规矩，定是有道理的。怎么听到如情耳里，好像王爷对太祖皇帝有不满似的？”
李骁双眸微眯，“姑娘说话可真有趣。明明就是你埋怨指责太祖皇帝颁发的规矩，居然还倒打一耙了。”
如情眨着眼，“王爷这话可就过了。如情一直谨守着太祖皇帝定下的规矩，大门不出，二门不迈，并不轻易私见外男。可王爷却质疑如情这般谨守太祖皇帝的规矩，还有何乐趣可言。这不明摆着王爷在指责英明神武的太祖皇帝他老人家嘛。”见李骁一副要生吃她的表情，如情越发得意，又道：“这话可是您亲口说的哦，在场诸位大人长辈都是证据哦。”然后看着李骁如吞了黄莲的表情，心里可爽快了，总算出了口恶气了。
你丫的，想倒打一耙，没门儿。
知义眉毛渐渐舒展，反倒是其他人却一脸的惊惶，纷纷冲脸色沉下来的李骁道：“王爷，不关下官的事呀，下官什么也没听到，什么也没听到。”
李骁心里堵得厉害，他居然被一个小丫头给堵得哑口无言。偏如情还捂着唇讽笑道：“王爷果然不同凡响，一个眼神射出去，就让所有人附首称臣，如情佩服。”
这下子，李骁脸色更黑了。这个，这个……可恶的巧言令色又巧舌如篁的臭丫头。
而其他人听了，吓得魂飞魄散，只得强撑着笑脸对李骁道：“王爷，下官家中还有事，先走一步。”然后其他人也有样学样，纷纷起身告辞，就怕被李骁如情牵了进去成了炮灰。
李骁并未阻拦这些人的离去，只是一个劲儿地瞪着如情。
如情虽然得意了一会，但见这些人离去，也有点儿惊惶，尤其李骁这家伙看着好生古怪，瞪她的目光并不像发怒，反倒带着她读不出的奇怪光茫。
“好厉害的一嘴张，黑的都能说成白的了，本王长这么大，还是第一次遇上。”他一双眸子冷溲溲地瞟了知义，冷笑一声：“师弟可真好运气，有这么伶牙俐齿的妹妹。”
知义淡淡一笑。道：“过奖。反正日后倒霉的只是我那未来妹夫，妹妹什么性子，也碍不着王爷。”
李骁滞住，又恶狠狠瞪了知义。而知义却不甩他，只是转头对如情道：“听说年前向家公子就有写信来，这个时候仍是没有着落，估计在驿站耽搁了，走，咱们去驿站问问看。”然后又拱手与李骁告辞。
而这时候的李骁却瞪着他们的背影，好一番咬牙切齿。待他们消失在楼梯后，又忽然觉得胸口闷闷的。

“这该死的臭丫头。”李骁恨恨捶了桌子，震得桌面上的杯盘碰碰作响。
身后的小太监见怪不怪地眼观鼻，鼻观心，反倒是李骁身边的新任侍卫却吓了一跳，担忧又惊奇地望着自家主子。
李骁喝了口酒，仍是不解心中怒火，“小顺子，你说，这丫头是不是很可恨。”
小太监立马恭身弯腰，“王爷说得是，这方家姑娘确实可恨。”
“她这样的人，居然还会有婆家要她，你说还有没有天理。”
“是没天理。”
“所以，为了我表弟，我把信截下来，应该没错吧。”
“王爷一心为舅老爷一家着想，奴才着实钦佩。”
李骁稍稍顺了气，又喃喃自语道：“表弟温柔敦厚，人又老实，若是娶了这小丫头，这日后恐怕就永远宁日了吧？”
小柱子不敢吱声，只是小小声地劝解：“王爷，这方姑娘是太王妃亲自给表少爷挑选的。”
李骁忽然来了气，怒道：“也不知母妃什么眼光，京里那么大家闺秀，偏就选中了她。”
小柱子不敢再说话。倒是一旁的新任侍卫周勇自告奋勇道：“王爷，那臭丫头如此可恨，惹王爷发这么大的火，干脆卑职今晚偷偷潜进将军府，把她抓出来再狠狠痛打一顿。给王爷出口恶气，岂不更好？”
李骁顿了会，忽然瞟他一眼，陡地斥道：“你敢？”
content_en:
6 tit for tat (2)
Previously, the atmosphere in the Tang Dynasty was very open, and women wore topless clothes and showed their breasts, making them feel uncomfortable. However, after the Song Dynasty, women's status was gradually lowered. In this dynasty, it has become even more serious, and it has evolved to the point where ladies are not allowed to go out or go out, and they are not allowed to meet foreign men at will.
At the beginning of the Daqing Dynasty, after Emperor Taizu conquered the country, he gradually placed more emphasis on literati. By the time of Emperor Gaozu, the power of the civil servants had gradually been enlarged, while military generals gradually faded out of the core of political power. During the Daqing Dynasty, under the leadership of the civil servant group, men had unprecedented power in the family, while women were gradually cooped up in the inner house, dependent on men for survival, and were not allowed to go out easily. Especially in the House of Bells and Ding Ming Shi, the women's speech and appearance are even more severe. The Fang family relies on its scholarly disciples and attaches great importance to the education of girls.
Although Ruqing is a time-travelling girl, after arriving here, she can't find any other way besides trying to adapt. She does not have Rushan's spirit of daring to fight and fight for herself, nor is she as good as Ruzhenrumei, who can stand out in front of people who are not as good as her with the halo of being a legitimate daughter. Even in front of high-ranking ladies, she has straightened her back and behaved as a human being.
In other words, most Ruqing doesn't care much about those looks of sympathy, pity, ridicule or disdain, but when encountering a few individuals, he will get furious. For example, the princess she met last time at Dai Wang's Mansion, and the Li Xiao in front of her who always liked to make trouble for her, knew that these people were of noble status and would not dare to offend her even if they screwed her head ten times... But, but, when she saw these arrogant faces, she really wanted to slap her with her shoe at all costs.
Li Xiao came back from being sarcastic, and immediately raised his eyebrows and said: "So, the girl is complaining about Grandpa Taizu's incompetence?" This was a bit harsh, and it also involved questioning and complaining about Emperor Taizu. Everyone present gradually changed their expressions.
Zhiyi frowned even more fiercely and glared at Li Xiao with dissatisfaction. He was about to speak, but Ruqing actually spoke first: "Your Majesty, this is enough. Emperor Taizu's great achievements could not be finished in three days. The rules set by his old man must be reasonable. Why did Ruqing hear that the prince was dissatisfied with Emperor Taizu?"
Li Xiao narrowed his eyes slightly, "It's really interesting what you say, girl. It's obviously you who complained about the rules issued by Emperor Taizu, but you actually defeated them."
Ruqing blinked and said, "Your Majesty, that's enough. Ruqing has always adhered to the rules set by Emperor Taizu. She never left the front door or stepped outside the second door, and did not easily meet her foreign husband in private. But the prince questioned what fun Ruqing had in abiding by Emperor Taizu's rules. This did not mean that the prince was blaming Ying Mingshen. Emperor Taizu of Wu is an old man." Seeing Li Xiaoru's expression of wanting to eat her alive, Ruqing became even more proud and said, "You said this yourself, and all the adults and elders present are the evidence." Then looking at Li Xiaoru's expression after swallowing Huang Lian, he felt relieved and finally felt bad.
Damn you, if you want to beat me up, there's no way.
Zhiyi's eyebrows gradually widened, but others looked frightened. They all said to Li Xiao, whose face darkened: "Your Majesty, it's none of Xiaguan's business. Xiaguan didn't hear anything. He didn't hear anything."
Li Xiao was so choked up that he was actually silenced by a little girl. Ruqing covered her lips and said with a sarcastic smile: "The prince is indeed extraordinary. With just one look, everyone can bow to him. Ruqing admires him."
This time, Li Xiao's face turned darker. This, this...that hateful, sweet-tongued and eloquent stinky girl.
When the others heard this, they were so frightened that they could only force a smile on their faces and said to Li Xiao: "Your Majesty, I have something to do at home, so let's go first." Then the others followed suit and stood up to leave,He was afraid that he would be dragged in by Li Xiaoruqing and become cannon fodder.
Li Xiao did not stop these people from leaving, but just stared at Ruqing.
Although Ruqing was proud for a while, she was a little frightened when she saw these people leaving, especially Li Xiao, who looked so weird. His gaze at her didn't look like he was angry, but instead had a strange glint that she couldn't read.
"You open your mouth so powerfully that you can say black things are white. This is the first time I have encountered her in my life." He glanced at Zhiyi with cold eyes and sneered: "Junior brother is so lucky to have such a sharp-tongued sister."
Zhiyi smiled faintly. He said: "Thank you. Anyway, it will only be my future brother-in-law who will be unlucky in the future. Whatever my sister's temperament is, it will not affect the prince."
Li Xiao paused and glared at Zhiyi fiercely. But Zhiyi did not abandon him, but turned to Ruqing and said, "I heard that Mr. Xiang wrote a letter years ago, but it is still missing at this time. He may have been delayed at the inn. Come on, let's go to the inn to ask." Then he said goodbye to Li Xiao.
But at this time, Li Xiao stared at their backs and gritted his teeth. After they disappeared down the stairs, they suddenly felt a tightness in their chest again.
"This damn stinky girl." Li Xiao punched the table angrily, causing the cups and plates on the table to clink.
The little eunuch behind him looked at his nose and heart without any surprise, but the new guard beside Li Xiao was startled, looking at his master with worry and surprise.
Li Xiao took a sip of wine, still puzzled by the anger in his heart, "Xiao Shunzi, tell me, is this girl very hateful?"
The young eunuch immediately bowed down respectfully, "Your Majesty is right, this girl from the Fang family is indeed hateful."
"For a person like her, her husband's family would want her. Do you think there is any reason for this?"
"It's unreasonable."
"So, for my cousin, I intercepted the letter, it should be right."
"Your Majesty cares about my uncle and his family wholeheartedly, and I really admire him."
Li Xiao calmed down a little, and murmured to himself: "My cousin is gentle, kind, and honest. If I marry this little girl, I'm afraid I'll be peaceful forever in the future, right?"
Xiaozhu didn't dare to say a word, but just tried to persuade her in a low voice: "Your Majesty, this girl Fang was personally selected by the Princess Tai for Young Master Cousin."
Li Xiao suddenly became angry and said angrily: "I don't know what my mother and concubine think of her. She is so beautiful among all the ladies in Beijing, but she was chosen."
Xiaozhu didn't dare to speak anymore. On the other hand, Zhou Yong, the new bodyguard on the side, volunteered and said, "My lord, that stinky girl is so hateful and made the prince so angry. Why don't I sneak into the general's mansion tonight, take her out and give her a good beating? Wouldn't it be better to vent my anger on the prince?"
Li Xiao paused for a while, then suddenly glanced at him and scolded: "How dare you?"
